# Northvalley Intelligence

Northvalley Intelligence is a software consultancy with three services: software development, agentic applications, and data science, machine learning and data cleansing. We design, build and integrate software for organizations that need it to work with the systems they already run.

Primary site: https://northvalleyintel.com
Contact: hello@northvalleyintel.com
Local-business service area focus: Marietta, Cobb County, Paulding County, Douglas County, and nearby Atlanta metro service areas.

## What Northvalley Does

Northvalley is a software consultancy in Marietta, Georgia that builds custom software and agentic applications and does data science and data cleansing, for organizations anywhere in the United States. The public website speaks in customer language because local service business owners usually start with lead, follow-up, scheduling, and workflow problems rather than software requirements.

For local service businesses, Northvalley also improves the full path from local discovery to lead conversion to operational follow-through. Those conversations become the entry point for better workflow, automation, AI-agent systems, and custom software when that is the right next step.

The work includes:

- Software development (web and mobile, custom integrations)
- Agentic applications
- Data science, machine learning and data cleansing
- Local business: Website Growth Assessment
- Local business: Google Ads management
- Local business: agent-native service surface, making a business usable directly from inside an AI assistant

## Capabilities

Northvalley Intelligence is a software consultancy with three services: software development, agentic applications, and data science, machine learning and data cleansing. We design, build and integrate software for organizations that need it to work with the systems they already run. We work with clients anywhere in the United States, remotely from Marietta, Georgia.

### Core — software development

- Web and mobile applications: Browser-based applications, the phone apps (iOS and Android) that share their backend, and the services behind them: accounts, payments, data, reporting. Proof: Smart Cash Sheet: a personal cash-flow app on the web with iOS and Android apps that share its backend. Northvalley runs its engineering: bank-data import, subscriptions and billing, and the release process. See Client Work.
- Custom integrations: Software that connects to the systems you already use — external APIs, vendor platforms and line-of-business systems — and puts their data to work in one place. Proof: For Canon Insurance Advisers: a retention board that surfaces policies at risk of lapsing before they end.
- Agentic applications: Software agents that take actions inside a business's own systems, with voice and chat front ends and agent-callable backends (MCP). Proof: A working demo of a voice-first field companion for a pest-control route: the technician speaks, the agent reads and updates the CRM through an agent-callable backend.

### Data science and cleansing — led by the founder

- Data science, machine learning and data cleansing: Data cleansing, entity normalization and matching, ontology, ranking and search relevance, and machine learning models, on messy real-world data. Proof: Founder Ferosh Jacob, Ph.D.: at CareerBuilder (2013–2015), a machine learning-based school and company normalization system and candidate-profile matching across data sources; at The Home Depot (2015–2021), machine learning ranking models, a search-evaluation framework and a product ontology; at Genuine Parts Company (2024–2026), catalog, search and discovery with generative AI and classical machine learning; publications since 2010, including the 2016 Springer chapter "Data Science and Big Data Analytics at CareerBuilder".
- LLM fine-tuning: Adapting open-source language models to a specific task, trained and run on local hardware (GPU or CPU) so data stays in-house. Proof: A published experiment by the founder: a LoRA-tuned Llama-3.2-3B and a fine-tuned cross-encoder that grade e-commerce search relevance, both ahead of the prompted baseline on two public datasets; presented with Jiho Noh (Kennesaw State University) at SCD 2026.

## Website Growth Assessment

The Website Growth Assessment is not a generic SEO score, security scan, or technical website doctor. It is an entry point for understanding whether lead generation, conversion, and follow-up problems point to better workflow, automation, or custom software.

It reviews whether a local business website helps nearby customers and AI answer engines understand:

- what the business does
- where the business serves
- why the business can be trusted
- what action a visitor should take next
- where contact, estimate, consultation, or booking friction exists

A one-page teaser report is emailed after request. The full paid assessment includes page-level evidence, scoring logic, exact missing signals, and prioritized fixes.

## Agent-Native Service Delivery

Northvalley builds agent-native service surfaces so a customer can use a business
directly from inside the AI assistant they are already using, instead of being
handed a list of names and a phone number.

The design rule is that the assistant submits a REQUEST and never confirms a
commitment. The business owner reviews and confirms the work. This is enforced in
code, not only in wording.

An agent lane is added onto the intake a business already has, so there is one
record, one notification, and one set of rules rather than a parallel booking
system the owner has to check separately.

Northvalley runs its own agent-native surface:

- Endpoint: https://northvalleyintel.com/mcp (Model Context Protocol, public, no auth)
- Tools: list_services, request_assessment, request_consult
- request_assessment submits a request for a Website Growth Assessment. It never
  returns assessment findings, scores, or report content. The one-page teaser is
  emailed; the complete assessment is a paid engagement.
- request_consult submits a request to talk about custom software or an
  agent-native surface. It does not book or confirm a meeting.
- Both write tools return a pending status for Northvalley to review.
- Northvalley works with clients anywhere in the United States. There is no
  service-area gate; the Cobb, Paulding, and Douglas county focus is an input to
  the lead-growth analysis inside an assessment, not a limit on who it works with.

Client reference implementation, live today:

- Business: Medina Clean, a bilingual residential and small-business cleaning
  service near Woodstock, Georgia.
- Endpoint: https://medinaclean.com/mcp (Model Context Protocol, public, no auth)
- Tools: check_service_area, list_services, get_pricing_rules, get_estimate,
  request_appointment
- Behavior: service-area check gates estimates and booking; appointment requests
  return a pending status for owner review; responses are available in English
  and Spanish.
- Added onto the existing appointment intake, so requests reach the owner through
  the same path the website form already used.

Northvalley builds and operates these surfaces for client businesses as a service.

Recorded demonstration: a customer asks ChatGPT for a house cleaning near
Woodstock, Georgia. ChatGPT checks Medina Clean's real service area, returns a
$150 starting estimate for 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms every 2 weeks from their
real pricing rules, files a booking request that reaches the owner with a
pending-review status, and answers the same request in Spanish. The request is
not a confirmed appointment; Rosa confirms it. Full transcript and FAQ:
https://northvalleyintel.com/case-studies/chatgpt-booking-medina-clean

## Client Work Examples

Northvalley shows selected client work as proof of practical customer-facing
systems, not as a generic website portfolio.

- Resplendent Tea Experience, Terri Hitzig: local service presentation for afternoon tea catering, custom pastries, events, service areas, and quote requests.
- Medina Clean, Rosa Medina: bilingual cleaning business presence connected to guided estimates, appointment requests, reviews, and operating-system foundations. Also reachable from inside AI assistants at https://medinaclean.com/mcp, where a customer can check the service area, get a starting estimate, and request a cleaning that Rosa confirms herself.
- Oscar's Package Store, James Jacob: local landmark package store presence focused on trust, selection, drive-through convenience, hours, directions, and direct calling.
- Clarity Mesh LLC: expertise-led professional services presence for architecture, modernization, cloud, data, search, and delivery consulting.
- C&J Welding, C&J Welding and Fabricating, Inc.: material-shapes reference for welding and fabrication customers preparing for quote conversations.
- Canon Insurance Advisers, Canon Insurance Advisers, LLC: public website for a Georgia insurance practice covering trucking, home, auto, and life lines, with a clear path from a coverage question to a quote conversation. Also a retention board that surfaces policies at risk of lapsing, including pending cancellations, non-renewals, and steep renewal increases, so the agency can reach the client before the policy ends.
- The CFR, The Center for Family Resources: complimentary website and experience evaluation for a Cobb County nonprofit in Marietta serving families facing housing loss, plus a set of Google Business Profile photos. Provided at no cost, not a paid engagement. Always written as "The CFR" with the article, never as bare "CFR".

Visible testimonial:

- Terri Hitzig: "Website Genius."
- Rosa Medina: "You are making my dream come true."
